land.text: Soviet Russia, whose land Cliopatria draws as the 'Russian Republic' 1918-1919 (see the russian-republic dossier)

predecessors.note: The Cliopatria row that precedes this one in time; its 1918-1919 shapes are Soviet Russia's.

land.text: the four founding republics (the RSFSR, the Ukrainian SSR, the Byelorussian SSR and the Transcaucasian SFSR) that signed the union treaty of 30 December 1922

successors.note: The page's lead: the Soviet Union 'was formed in 1922 by a treaty between the Soviet republics of Byelorussia' and the others; infobox 'Created: 30 December 1922'.

keyframe_review.note: 21.48 M km2 for 1920-1921: the land of the Soviet republics the page lists for those years (Russian SFSR 7 November 1917; Ukrainian SSR 10 March 1919; Azerbaijan SSR 28 April 1920; Byelorussian SSR 31 July 1920; Bukharan and Khorezm People's Soviet Republics 1920-1924; Far Eastern Republic 1920-1922; Armenian SSR 2 December 1920). A gazetteer comparison finds the shape holds Azerbaijan (311 of 330 cells), Armenia (109 of 116), the Bukhara and Khorezm oases, eastern Belarus (573 of 925) and Ukraine without Galicia and Volhynia (1,825 of 2,360), and the Far East with the Maritime Province (779 of 783); it lacks Georgia (4 of 273 cells) and northern Sakhalin, and holds Crimea (83 of 106) and Tuva (618 of 631) throughout. The page gives no area. The shape is the union of the members' own dossiers (type umbrella): it should not be coloured as territory of its own.

correction.text: the 1920 shape plus Georgia, where the Georgian SSR was established on 25 February 1921 (the page's table)

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria holds one shape for 1920 and 1921 and gives Georgia to the Soviet Union only in 1922, a year after the Georgian SSR (table: 25 February 1921). The Armenian SSR (2 December 1920) is already in the 1920 shape, so Armenia is Soviet from the shape's first year.

ledger.note: 1920: the Soviet republics stand as one bloc. Cliopatria draws Soviet Russia and the republics beside it (Ukraine, Byelorussia, Azerbaijan, Bukhara, Khorezm, the Far Eastern Republic) as one shape from 1920; the page lists these republics with their establishment dates but names no 1920 union, so the start year is Cliopatria's.

1920: the Bukharan People's Soviet Republic takes the Emirate of Bukhara's land. The page lists the Bukharan People's Soviet Republic as 1920-1924; the Soviet Union page (opened for the USSR dossier) calls the Bukharan and Khorezm republics 'Soviet dependencies' that were merged in 1924.
1920: the Khorezm People's Soviet Republic takes the Khanate of Khiva's land. The page lists it as 1920-1924.

1920: the last Whites hold Crimea. The page: 'the extended siege of the last White forces in Crimea in 1920'; the Cliopatria shape already draws Crimea as Soviet, so the contest is added for the year.
1920, 28 April: Soviet Azerbaijan is established. The page's table gives the Azerbaijan SSR as established on 28 April 1920; the shape holds Azerbaijan from 1920.

region.text: the eastern part of Belarus that lies in the 1920 shape (573 of 925 gazetteer cells)

ledger.note: 1920, 31 July: Soviet Byelorussia is established. The page's table gives the Byelorussian SSR as established on 31 July 1920; the Peace of Riga of March 1921 'split disputed territories in Belarus and Ukraine between Poland and Soviet Russia/Soviet Ukraine' (Russian Civil War page), so only the eastern part (573 of 925 gazetteer cells) lies in the shape. [Reviewer eu-17-b, 2026-10-31: region narrowed from all of Belarus to its part inside the 1920 shape, as this note already states.]
1920, November: the Whites leave Crimea. The page: 'Wrangel and the remains of his army were evacuated to Constantinople in November 1920.'
1920, 2 December: Soviet Armenia is proclaimed. The page's table gives the Armenian SSR as 2 December 1920 (not 29 November, as some accounts have it).

region.text: all the member republics, which become the founding republics of the USSR

ledger.note: 1921: Cliopatria's bloc of Soviet republics ends; the four founding republics sign the treaty creating the Soviet Union on 30 December 1922. The page gives 30 December 1922 ('Created') for the Union and no end for a 1920-21 bloc, so the end year is Cliopatria's.
1921, 25 February: Soviet Georgia is proclaimed. The page's table gives the Georgian SSR as 25 February 1921; Cliopatria draws Georgia as Soviet only from 1922.

wars.name: Russian Civil War, last phase (1920-21)

zones.text: the last White forces besieged in Crimea in 1920

wars.outcome: Wrangel's army was evacuated from Crimea in November 1920; by 1921 'the Bolsheviks had defeated the national movements in Ukraine and the Caucasus'.
wars.note: The page gives no 1920-21 dates for the Caucasus (Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia); those come from the republics table of the Republics page.

wars.name: Polish-Soviet War
wars.outcome: The Peace of Riga, March 1921, 'split disputed territories in Belarus and Ukraine between Poland and Soviet Russia/Soviet Ukraine'.
wars.note: The Cliopatria shape already excludes the Polish-held west, so no zone is listed; the war is carried by the Second Polish Republic and Ukrainian dossiers.

certainty.note: A wartime bloc with moving fronts; the Polish frontier was fixed only at Riga in March 1921 and the Far East was a Japanese-screened buffer.

sources.title: Republics of the Soviet Union
sources.note: The table of Soviet republics before 1922 with establishment dates (Azerbaijan 28 April 1920, Byelorussia 31 July 1920, Armenia 2 December 1920, Georgia 25 February 1921, Bukhara, Khorezm, Far Eastern Republic) and the 30 December 1922 treaty; no area.

sources.title: Russian Civil War
sources.note: Crimea 1920, Wrangel's evacuation in November 1920, the Peace of Riga; also used by the sibling dossiers.

sources.title: Soviet Union
sources.note: Opened for the USSR dossier: the 1924 formation of Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan from the Turkestan ASSR and 'two Soviet dependencies', the Khorezm and Bukharan republics.

sources.title: Tuvan People's Republic
sources.note: Opened for the USSR dossier: Tuva declared independence on 14 August 1921 and stayed outside the Soviet Union until 1944.

sources.title: Far Eastern Republic
sources.note: Opened for the Priamurye dossier; here it only confirms the Republic's life (6 April 1920 to 15 November 1922), listed on the Republics page.

notes:
Pages: 2 in the budget (the Republics page and the Russian Civil War page) plus the Far Eastern Republic page read for the Priamurye dossier.

What this row is: Cliopatria's 'Republics of the Soviet Union' for 1920-1921 is the union of Soviet Russia and the Soviet republics beside it (21.48 M km2); its Wikipedia article is the page on the 15 union republics of 1956-1991, which says nothing about 1920-21 as a bloc. The row duplicates the land of the RSFSR, Ukrainian SSR, Byelorussian SSR, Azerbaijan SSR and the people's republics, which have their own dossiers; it is therefore typed umbrella (not territory of its own) and the renderer should draw the members. If the colour agent wants a territorial state for 1920-21, russian-soviet-federative-socialist-republic is the nearest.

Not settled: (1) northern Sakhalin is missing from the shape from 1920 (Japanese occupation 'until 1925', Far Eastern Republic page, start undated); the occupation pair is carried in the USSR dossier; (2) East Karelia, Estonia, Latvia and Finland's treaties of 1920 are on no page opened; (3) Tuva (Tuvan People's Republic proclaimed 14 August 1921, Tuvan page) is inside the shape throughout, which is wrong for 1921; (4) the Far Eastern Republic is listed on the Republics page among the Soviet republics but was a nominally independent buffer state (its own dossier); (5) no page gives the Georgian SSR's conquest beyond the 25 February 1921 table date. Counterparts without a dossier: azerbaijan-democratic-republic and armenia and georgia are Cliopatria slugs.
